Summer rules for the late crew
This section explains the steps that matter

Companion Animal Travel Desk Care and Travel Review

This section sets the standard for careful handling, calm communication, and consistent welfare checks for animals booked through Aurelia Skyways. Staff must welcome each passenger in a steady and respectful manner, gather the travel details that affect safety, and confirm that the pet is accepted under the current service rules before any booking is finalized. When a concern is raised, the desk should listen closely, note the facts clearly, and direct the case to the welfare coordinator for review.

For rabbit travel, <<FACT F064>> The desk should then confirm crate readiness, ventilation, and clear labeling, while also checking that the passenger understands the limits on feeding, water access, and transfer handling. Any sign of distress, illness, or poor crate condition must be treated as a service concern and escalated without delay. A passenger who arrives with incomplete documents or unsuitable equipment should receive a calm explanation of what is missing and what must be corrected before acceptance can continue.

For large dog travel, <<FACT F075>> The desk should verify the booking against the approved route, confirm that the animal can be managed safely by the ramp and cabin teams, and make sure the owner receives simple guidance on exercise, rest, and handover steps before departure. If the passenger appears unsure, staff should slow the process, restate the requirements in clear language, and involve a supervisor when the case needs extra support. The cabin team must be informed of any animal that needs special observation so that attention remains steady throughout the journey.

All records should be complete, legible, and entered before the booking is closed. Any unusual handling issue, customer complaint, or welfare concern must be passed to the senior coordinator for review. For further guidance, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
